title: Fourier norm bound by tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ Boolean coordinates with real-valued leaves, and let $f$ be the function computed by $T$. The sum of the absolute values of the vector Fourier coefficients of $f$ is at most the supremum of $|f|$ on the Boolean cube multiplied by $2^{\mathrm{depth}(T)}$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued decision tree on $n$ Boolean coordinates
A real-valued function $f$ on the Boolean cube
